notes.title: Major Update. Tarzan Trilogy Edition is NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Tarzan VR: Trilogy Edition, the complete series, is out now! 

Thanks to all of our fans for your patience and support. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring you a truly complete Tarzan experience. Not only does this mean the release of brand-new content in the form of Issue #3, but also a significant update to Issues #1 & 2.

Issue #3 features the Strongbow!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35459063/0130584f052bb21fd5ead6b42fce4e4c39cbe406.png[/img]

You'll also discover flaming arrows, and even a rhinoceros to fight alongside. Be sure to explore all the secrets of Tarzan Island!

We’re proud to bring you a complete upgrade that includes improved performance, graphical updates, and gameplay rebalancing. As a thank you for your patience, we are releasing this Trilogy Edition as a completely FREE update to current owners of Issue #1 on Steam.

Good luck in Issue #3 – THE DEAD OF NIGHT!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35459063/e92ab1a97c234fdd51c72031564cd7543bb529d4.png[/img]

If you are interested in creating gameplay content for us, please request a key via our discord. https://discord.gg/8dQv9wTkAx

Many thanks to the Stonepunk & VR Monkey teams for their hard work on this release.

notes.title: Issue #3 "The Dead of Night"
notes.content:
Happy Holidays to all Tarzan fans wherever you may be!

[h3]Issue #3 [/h3]
[b][i]The Dead of Night[/i][/b] DLC page has just gone public and is coming soon. Make sure you Wishlist the page to be notified when it drops.  This episode will be the conclusion of the game and will feature weapons such as the [b]Strong Bow[/b], a new animal companion and even a confrontation with the Spider Queen  🕸. There are some additional surprises that we don't want to spoil... so don't miss this one! 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35459063/0130584f052bb21fd5ead6b42fce4e4c39cbe406.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35459063/e5560a13111a53d7234642460b0f6a753c62390c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378241/Tarzan_VR_Issue_3__THE_DEAD_OF_NIGHT/

[h3]Jungle Bugs Squashed! 🦟 🔨[/h3]

Stonepunk Studios has implemented a few changes to Issue 1 & Issue 2 which address some bugs reported by players over the past several weeks. 

[u][b]General:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Exit level portal triggers adjusted.
[*] Bad Guys will no longer get disconnected from their colliders in certain circumstances.
[/list]
[u][b]Issue 1:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The Great Ape's eyes will no longer track player after his scene concludes.
[*] Combat music will not play over Great Ape sequence if all enemies are not defeated.
[/list]
[u][b]Issue 2:
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Log path walkway collider slightly wider and fixed missing colliders.
[*] Cave Wasps won't fly through cave walls as often.
[*] Brutus boss fight cannot no longer be skipped by jumping the barrier.
[*] Optimizations to cave meshes to improve performance.
[/list]

If you are enjoying Tarzan, please be sure to let us know in the Steam reviews.  We read each and every one and greatly value your feedback.

See you all in Issue #3!

notes.title: Issues 1 & 2 Release & Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35459063/180be200462b8621fe3b6bb38407901f95fa6629.gif[/img]

Part 1 & 2 of the game have officially rolled out and we're already seeing  videos of players having an amazing time discovering the [b]hidden secrets[/b] on Tarzan Island, learning tips and tricks on [b]hand-to-hand combat[/b],  [b]vine attacks[/b], using the [b]Super Sling Shot[/b] or even summoning [b]Numa the Lion[/b] to aid in the fight. 
[list]

[*] [h3][b]Issue #1 [/b][/h3]This first episode grants you Tarzan Island as well as part 1 of the story.  Tarzan's island may evolve and reveal even more secrets over time so keep your eyes peeled!  Don't swim too deep without finding a breath pod in a clam!

[*] [h3][b]Issue #2[/b] [/h3]The second episode allows you to master the [b]Super Slingshot[/b] (or your fists) and the ability to call upon animals to defend you.  Look out for wasps!  This is a much more challenging episode so come prepared & be ready to adapt your playstyle to this rocky landscape.
[/list]

[u][b]Get ready to rumble! [/b][/u]  Stonepunk Studios is also rolling out some wild updates for the weekend so be sure to download.

[h2]Combat:[/h2]
[list]
[*]The overall difficulty of the combat is different with each play.
[*] Grunt health, attack style and disorientation are now more randomized. 
[*] Base Enemy & Base Heavy health & difficulty now increased and randomized. 
[*] More Grunts are stationed at the initial fist-fight, and at the air attack tutorial (Tarzan Vine Attack)
[*] Grenade Soldiers no longer accidently blow themselves up (unless Tarzan whacks grenade)
[*] Increased aggression of Numa the Lion (Issue 2)
[/list]

[h2]Various[/h2]
[list]
[*] LIV Mixed Reality fixes for issue 2
[*] Final Quicksand fix (Issue 2)
[*] Added hints to Brutus's Tower of Power (Issue 2)
[*] Secret "Credits Cave" titles fix
[*] Ape escape waypoints tweaked
[*] Sea predator danger music now plays
[*] Several audio fixes
[/list]

The "Lord of the Jungle Bundle" contains Issue 1 (plus island), Issue 2 as well as the OST with over 50 tracks, some of which are found as secret items within the game.  We're running a discount on the bundle for launch.   Issue #3 coming soon. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/17980/

Do you have what it takes to become Lord of the Jungle?  Comment below.

* Fistfight screenshot courtesy of Rhys Da King.
